V48.interpretation: All-pair sums remain signed. Opposite pairs are a post-hoc descriptive subset, aligned separately by each gap sign before positive and negative aggregation. Atomic and grouped views use independent gross-positive denominators and are not additive. Only charged query time is compared; no tail commit is assigned to either position.

interpretation: Each query delta is V46 minus V39; gap is delta32 minus delta33. Eleven atomic parts and four groups are alternative additive views, never added together. Reverse pairs require opposite query-delta signs and both absolute deltas strictly greater than 1 ms. Each reverse gap is aligned by its sign. Positive support and negative offsets are computed per pair and component before aggregation; shares use each view own gross positive support, not net. Aligned component support describes the gap, not necessarily opposite signs in that component. Remainders retain signed rounding differences; their names do not identify an observed activity. Full-six signed totals and post-hoc reverse subsets are separate. No sums of medians or MADs are treated as total costs. Warmups and tail commits are excluded. These are previously exposed, non-simultaneous wall-time records, not causal effects of decoder, CPU, I/O or host load.
